entries.content: (c-0) (The title of this book, 'Ezekiel'), Meaning, 'Strength of God.' captives (d-25) Lit. 'captivity.'
Jehoiachin's (e-14) Or 'Joiachin's;' elsewhere called also 'Jeconias,' and 'Coniah.'
itself, (f-21) Or 'mingled,' as Ex. 9.24. brass, (g-39) An unknown substance; some think a mixture of gold and silver. so in ver. 27; and ch. 8.2; see Rev. 1.15.
and (a-4) Or 'So were their faces; and.'
with (d-21) Or 'over against,' or 'beside,' as ch. 3.13, &c. creature (e-29) Some read 'spirit of life.' so in ver. 21 and ch. 10.17.
noise (f-8) Lit. 'voice.' so ch. 3.12, 'sound.' host. (g-32) Or 'camp.'
brass, (h-9) See Note g to ver. 4.

impudent (a-5) Lit. 'stiff of face.' see ch. 3.7. Jehovah. (b-24) Adonai Jehovah, characteristic of this prophet, used about 200 times. Adonai, a plural form of Adon, 'lord,' 'master,' is a name of God, not merely a title.
speech, (d-15) Lit. 'deep of lip, and heavy of tongue.'
soul (c-9) Or 'my person.' abominable (d-41) Or 'unclean,' as Lev. 7.18; 19.7; Isa. 65.4.
fire (a-9) Lit. 'light,' and so in Isa. 31.9.
it (b-24) i.e. still from the third part last mentioned. see Zech. 13.8,9.
ordinances (c-29) Or 'judgments;' so ch. 11.12; 'manner' in 2Kings 17.26,33. statutes, (d-35) choq, as Ex. 12.24.
ordinances, (c-32) Or 'judgments;' so ch. 11.12; 'manner' in 2Kings 17.26,33. statutes, (d-27) choq, as Ex. 12.24.
verily (e-9) Lit. 'if ... not.' A strong form of solemn declaration. see Num. 14.23.
astonishment (f-14) Or 'desolation,' as ch. 33.28,29, where both words are used.
idols; (b-23) A term of contempt, used 38 times in Ezekiel. See Lev. 26.30; Deut. 29.17; 1Kings 21.26.
idols; (b-15) A term of contempt, used 38 times in Ezekiel. See Lev. 26.30; Deut. 29.17; 1Kings 21.26.
their (c-24) Or 'because I am broken with their. ...'
have (d-10) Or 'that I, Jehovah, have not.'
Violence (b-1) As ver. 23; Zeph. 1.9. wealth, (c-22) A play on words here. them. (d-31) Or 'neither shall there be wailing for them.'
he (e-14) Lit. 'they.' Cf. Lev. 25, &c. revoked; (f-34) Or 'for the vision touching her noisy multitude shall not be revoked.' assure (g-41) Or 'strengthen.'
therein (a-12) Or 'of his beautiful ornament, he (i.e. the people) hath made his pride; and they have made therefrom.'
profaned. (c-32) Or 'they shall inherit their sanctuaries.'
Tammuz. (b-26) A Syrian and Phoenician idol identified with Adonis.
of (c-18) Or 'Cause to draw near the chastisements of,' &c.
slaughter (d-24) Lit. 'dashing-in-pieces;' Jer. 51.20, 'maul.' side; (e-46) Lit. 'on his loins.'
mark (f-21) The word is Tau, the name of the last letter of the Hebrew alphabet.
recompense (b-18) Lit. 'put,' as also ch. 22.31 and 1Kings 8.32.
time (b-7) Lit. 'not near.' houses. (c-10) See Jer. 29.5. this (d-11) i.e. the city. so vers. 7,11. see ch. 24.6.
God. (c-26) Lit. 'for a people for me, and I will be to them for God.'
with (d-9) Or 'heartily after.' recompense (e-18) As ch. 9.10.
proverb (c-25) See ch. 16.44. accomplishment (d-39) Lit. 'word,' 'matter,' dabar. see Ps. 119.11.
wrists, (b-17) Or 'armholes,' as Jer. 38.12. veils (a-21) Or 'kerchiefs.'
iniquity. (b-6) Or 'the punishment of the iniquity,' and so each time in this verse. see Lam. 4.6.
multiply, (a-5) Or 'made thee into myriads.' beauty; (b-25) Lit. 'to the ornament of ornaments.'
them? (a-16) Or 'in causing them to pass through [the fire] unto them;' or 'setting apart for them,' as Ex. 13.12. the like in ch. 20.26.
debauchery, (b-11) Or 'arched place;' and so vers. 31,39.
portion; (d-14) Or 'allotted food,' choq; see Ex. 12.24.
money (f-8) Lit. 'brass,' or 'copper.' out, (g-12) Some read 'thy defilement (or ''pollution'') has abounded.'
by (a-8) Or 'was not a lesson in.'
forgive (c-20) Kaphar; lit. 'make atonement for.' see Lev. 5.6; Deut. 21.8; 32.43.
land; (d-16) Heb. 'land of Canaan.' see ch. 16.29.
field; (e-16) Lit. 'in a field of sowing.'
many (f-9) Rab; or 'great,' as ver. 5. vine. (g-26) Lit. 'vine of magnificence.' see ver. 23, 'noble,' 'excellent,' and Jer. 30.21.
knew (b-3) Some read, 'he broke down.' palaces, (c-6) Or 'widows.' contained, (d-22) Lit. 'its fulness.'
rest, (e-9) Others translate 'like unto thee,' but reading uncertain.
thick (a-20) Or 'thick-leaved.' It may be, 'amidst the clouds; and so ch. 31.3,10,14.
ornament (b-37) As ver. 15; ch. 7.20, 'beautiful.' see Dan. 8.9.
devoted (b-12) Lit. 'transferred,' or 'caused to pass [through the fire].' see Note. ch. 16.21.
first-fruits (a-48) Or 'the choicest,' as 1Sam. 15.21; 2.29, 'primest.' things. (b-56) Or 'consecrated things.'
(c-0) In the Hebrew, ch. 21 commences at this verse.
south, (d-9) Heb. Teman, Hab. 3.3. south, (e-15) Heb. Darom. see Deut. 33.23. south (f-23) Heb. Negeb. see Josh. 10.40. Same word at end of verse, and ch. 21.4.
south, (f-8) Heb. Negeb. see Josh. 10.40. Same word at end of verse, and ch. 21.4. meets (a-51) Lit. 'every face' (i.e. every side of the forest, &c.). burned (b-60) Or 'scorched.'
wood? (d-27) 'It despiseth the rod of my son as [all] wood.'
privily. (e-42) Or 'is a terror unto them.'
glittering, (f-27) Or 'as lightning,' so vers. 10,28. whetted (g-30) Others read 'drawn.'
parting (b-9) Lit. 'mother.' teraphim, (c-31) i.e. household gods.
oppression, (b-23) Or 'exaction.' so ver. 29. overreached (c-19) Or 'got dishonest gain from.' see ver. 27, 'dishonest gain.'
overreaching (c-10) Or 'got dishonest gain from.' see ver. 27, 'dishonest gain.'
Oholah (a-5) Meaning, 'Her tent.' Oholibah (b-9) Meaning, 'My tent is in her.'
mine; (c-9) Or 'instead of remaining with me.'
rulers, (d-6) As Ezra 9.2; and so vers. 12,23.
Babylon, (a-4) Or 'Babel.' Koa, (b-13) Or 'governors, and nobles, and princes.' and see Jer. 50.21, Note b.
them (a-26) Or 'have also devoted unto them.' see Notes, chs. 16.21; 20.26. children, (b-28) Or 'sons.'
sort (c-18) Lit. 'from the crowd of men.' Sabeans (d-21) Possibly 'drunkards.' their (e-30) i.e. of the two sisters.
her (f-5) Or 'to her.' she. (g-18) Some read 'Will they now commit fornications [with her], even with her,' or 'and she [with them]?'
them (h-11) Or 'hew them in pieces.' cf. 21.19, Note.
bones; (a-18) Or 'and also the bones, in a pile at the bottom of it.'
well, (c-15) Or 'and make thick the broth.'
rust (b-9) Or 'scum.' fire. (e-22) Or 'her rust [doth not vanish] in the fire.'
strength, (a-19) Or 'fortress,' see Isa. 23.14; others 'confidence.' up (b-35) As 'music,' 1Chron. 15.22.
encampments (e-21) Enclosures for cattle, or tent villages. see Gen. 25.16; Num. 31.10.
Kerethites, (b-22) Or perhaps 'the Cretans.' see Zeph. 2.5. There is a paronomasia here.
daughters (c-3) i.e. her towns. see Josh. 17.11.
seas, (a-23) i.e. by those coming by way of the sea. therein! (b-49) Or 'that haunt it.'
situate (d-9) Or 'thou that dwellest.' isles, (e-23) Or 'maritime countries,' 'coasts.'
wise (h-7) Or 'skilful.' leaks; (i-15) Lit. 'making fast thy chinks;' perhaps 'thy calkers.' so ver. 27. thee. (k-31) Lit. 'barter thy barter.' so ver. 27.
Uzal (c-5) Probably Sanaa, the capital of Yemen, Arabia. see Gen. 10.27. traffic. (d-18) Lit. 'barter.' so vers. 25,33,34.
cedar-wood, (e-28) Or '... stuffs, bound firmly with cords.'
merchandise, (d-7) Lit. 'barter.' so vers. 25,33,34. leaks, (f-17) See Note i, ver. 9. thee, (g-23) See Note k, ver. 9.
God. (c-8) See ch. 31.9. workmanship (d-39) Or 'the service.'
the (e-3) Or 'an.' covering (f-5) i.e. 'protecting,' see Ex. 25.20.
then (a-35) Or '... scattered, then shall I be hallowed in ... nations; and.'
tremble. (a-35) Or 'didst bring to a stand-still.'
league, (b-22) Or 'land of the covenant.' see Dan. 11.22.
Ethiopia (a-15) Cush. them, (c-22) Or 'shall be in their midst.'
Aven (f-5) Or 'On' (Heliopolis). Aven means vanity. Pibeseth (g-8) Bubastis, in lower Egypt. these (h-15) i.e. the cities.
himself; (a-40) Or 'by themselves.' earth, (b-55) Lit. 'land of what is beneath;' and so vers. 16, 18; ch. 32.18,24.
seas; (c-34) Or 'waters;' the expression is often applied to a large river. see Isa. 19.5; Jer. 51.36.
[members]; (f-19) Or 'and fill the valleys with thy carrion.'
him (c-14) Or 'speak of him.' 'Strong' in this verse is el.
his (d-6) Lit. 'her;' so ver. 23, &c. graves (e-9) Alluding to the niches in sepulchral vaults.
princes (a-4) Lit. 'anointed ones,' as Ps. 83.11; Mic. 5.5.
warn (c-15) Heb. from zahar, 'to shine,' as Dan. 12.3; 'enlighten,' Ps. 19.11.
warning, (c-12) Heb. from zahar, 'to shine,' as Dan. 12.3; 'enlighten,' Ps. 19.11.
he (c-20) Or 'it,' referring to 'hand.' coming (d-27) Or 'until he should come;' cf. ch. 24.26,27.
land; (a-23) Or 'soil.' water-courses, (b-36) Or 'in the ravines.'
of (c-14) Lit. 'mountains of the height of.'
up (f-5) Or 'raise up,' as ver. 29; Isa. 52.2; 60.1; 'arise.'
bands (g-39) Or 'bars' (i.e. resting on the shoulder). it is the same expression as Lev. 26.13.
plant (h-9) Or 'planting,' 'plantation;' as Isa. 60.21. ignominy (i-27) Or 'confusion,' as ch. 32.24; 'shame,' Isa. 50.6.
up (a-22) Lit. 'panted after you.' see Ps. 56.1. talkers, (b-47) Heb. 'the tongue.'
pillage. (a-55) Or 'to take possession of it for a prey.'
children. (e-34) Some read 'cause them to fall.'
nation, (f-18) Some read 'nations,' and so in vers. 14,15.
bereave (g-9) Or 'cause to falter' or 'fall' (see ver. 15).
land. (b-25) Heb. Adamah, 'soil,' as ch. 34.13. In vers. 5, 18, 20, 28, 34, 35 it is Erets. see 1Sam. 2.8.
wind, (a-9) Ruach, 'spirit,' 'wind,' vers. 6, 8, 9, 10, 14, and often. breath, (b-30) Or 'Spirit, come from the four winds.'
graves, (c-27) See Dan. 12.2. land (d-36) or 'soil,' as ver. 21; ch. 36.24.
guard (c-22) Or 'chief,' 'commander.' Same word as 'watch,' Jer. 51.12.
visited; (d-7) Or 'Many days ago wast thou appointed.' safety. (e-59) Or 'at ease,' 'trustfully.' see 2Kings 18.19.
middle (a-41) Or 'high part,' as Judg. 9.37; lit. 'navel.'
lead (c-8) A word of uncertain meaning. Some translate 'I will divide thee into six parts.'
of (a-40) Or 'stifle.' Hamon-Gog. (b-60) Meaning, 'Multitude of Gog.'
bear (a-4) Or 'when they shall have borne.'
about. (b-18) Or 'the court round about the gate.'
closed (c-4) Or 'latticed,' or 'with fixed frames.' projections; (d-22) Or 'buttresses' (or 'piers'). The meaning of the Hebrew term is not clearly ascertained. palm-trees. (e-35) Or 'palms.'
south. (f-7) Heb. Darom, as ch. 20.46. so to ch. 42.18 (13 times). see Deut. 33.23.
rinsed (a-17) 'Thoroughly washed.' see 2Chron. 4.6; as 'scoured out,' Isa. 4.4.
tables (b-7) Some read 'four tables for the burnt-offering,' the Hebrew for 'ascent' and 'burnt-offering' being similar.

gate, (d-36) The text as given is according to LXX and modern critics. The Hebrew text reads '... were the cells of the singers in the inner court which was at the side of the north gate; and their front was towards the south. one was at the side of the east gate.'
eleven (a-12) LXX reads 'twelve.' whereby (b-18) Or 'and by ten steps.'
upward, (f-35) i.e. in ratio of elevation.
joint. (g-24) i.e. to the level place where the side chambers began.
house. (h-31) Or 'that were on the inner side.'
place (i-9) Or 'area,' and so all through. end (k-12) Lit. 'side.'
places (a-14) There were necessarily two, one on each side of the house.
galleries (b-22) Athik, a word the sense of which is uncertain. temple, (c-38) Or 'and the temple of the inner court.'
them (d-15) i.e. the three buildings in ver. 15, or the three porches of the inner court. covered), (e-38) * Lit. 'closely covered,' as 'concealed,' Prov. 11.13.
gallery (i-25) The meaning of the Hebrew word is disputed.
inward; (k-20) According to LXX and modern critics. The Hebrew reads 'one cubit.'
cells (b-4) Others read, 'And under it (i.e. under the wall, or enclosure) were these cells. the entry was,' &c.

south, (c-12) According to the LXX and others. see ver. 12. The Hebrew text reads 'east,' but the 'east' had nothing to do with 'the separate place,' which ran round the three sides only, north, west, and south.
[in] (a-65) Or '[and by].' places, (b-68) Or 'in their tombs.'

ground (d-7) Or 'of earth,' implying that the whole interior of the 'base' was 'of earth.' settle, (e-28) The entire base of the upper altar (Heb. Harel or 'Mount of *God,' see ver. 15) was in two parts, the upper of which was set back.
altar (f-4) Heb. Harel. *God (g-13) Heb. Ariel, 'lion of *God.' see Isa. 29.1.
purge (a-33) Or 'cleanse from sin (chata);' and so vers. 22,23; ch. 45.18. see Lev. 8.15.
it. (c-15) 'Fill the hand.' see Note, Ex. 28.41.
heart, (d-11) well (d-44) Lit. 'set thine heart to.'
things, (f-11) Or 'of my sanctuary,' but the word here is kodesh, as ver. 13; ch. 42.13. 'Sanctuary' here is mikdash; see Ex. 25.8.
things, (a-27) holy; (a-32) Kodesh; also 'sanctuary,' chs. 41.21,23; 42.14; 45.2. see ver. 8.
holy (a-31) Kodesh; also 'sanctuary,' chs. 41.21,23; 42.14; 45.2. see ver. 8.
holy (a-10) Kodesh; also 'sanctuary,' chs. 41.21,23; 42.14; 45.2. see ver. 8.
sanctuary, (a-10) sanctuary, (a-19) Kodesh; also 'sanctuary,' chs. 41.21,23; 42.14; 45.2. see ver. 8.
dough, (c-37) As Num. 15.20 and 'coarse meal,' Neh. 10.37.

maneh. (a-19) i.e. the mina, the sixtieth part of a talent. * It is the weight measure here, and equalled 60 shekels -- 20 + 25 + 15. As a gold coin it was valued at 50 shekels. see 1Kings 10.17; Ezra 2.69; Luke 19.13.
give; (a-23) Lit. 'the gift of his hand.' see Deut. 16.17.
unto; (a-29) Lit. 'the gift of his hand.' see Deut. 16.17.
give; (a-33) Lit. 'the gift of his hand.' see Deut. 16.17.
ordinance. (c-39) Lit. 'statutes for ever.' see Ex. 12.24.
fruit (a-36) Or 'ripe fruit,' as 'first-ripe,' Hos. 9.10. see Note b, Lev. 2.12; 23.17. month, (b-38) Lit. 'according to its months.'
from (e-24) Or 'And on the east side, between Hauran, Damascus and Gilead, and the land of Israel, is the Jordan. ye shall measure from.'
side (f-5) Side of the Negeb. see Josh. 10.40. torrent, (g-16) i.e. the river of Egypt. southward. (h-26) Toward the Negeb.
serve (a-8) Or 'cultivate;' or 'work it,' as 'till,' Gen. 2.5; i.e. the 'residue' of the land (ver. 18).
